params.name: environment
params.description: The environment to filter the statistics by. If not provided, statistics for all environments will be returned.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter runs by status(es). Define multiple with a comma-separated list. Supplying none will return all statuses.

params.name: start_at
params.description: Start date and time for statistics (inclusive)

params.name: end_at
params.description: End date and time for statistics (inclusive)

params.name: timezone
params.description: Timezone for the statistics (e.g., 'Europe/Berlin'). Defaults to UTC.

params.name: environment
params.description: Filter runs by environment. If not provided, all environments will be included.

items.docs: Generates statistics about runs over a specified time period.
